notes: Grades 1-8 use the new NCF-SE 2023 NCERT textbooks (Grades 1-2 from 2023-24, 3 and 6 from 2024-25, 4/5/7/8 from 2025-26).

Grade 9: CBSE introduced the NCF-SE 2023 scheme in Class IX in 2026-27 (CBSE circular Acad-14/2026). New NCERT books: Kaveri (English), Ganga (Hindi), Sharada (Sanskrit), Ganita Manjari Part 1 & 2 (Maths), Exploration (Science), Understanding Society: India and Beyond Part 1 & 2 (Social Science). Old books (Beehive/Moments, Kshitij/Kritika/Sparsh/Sanchayan, Shemushi, Mathematics, Science, Contemporary India-I, India and the Contemporary World-I, Democratic Politics-I, Economics) are retired for Class 9.

Grade 9 Ganita Manjari Part 2 (chapters 9-14) went on sale 21 Sep 2026; Understanding Society Part 2 on ~29-30 Sep 2026. Both are new books, so there is no CBSE 'deleted chapters' list for Grade 9 Maths/Science; content was restructured instead (e.g. Gravitation is folded into 'How Forces Affect Motion'; Reproduction moved from Class 10 to Class 9; new Earth-science chapter; Maths now includes coordinates, probability, sequences/AP-GP, algorithms, linear equations in two variables).

Grade 9 Social Science is ONE integrated book (Understanding Society: India and Beyond). It has been split here into history/geography/civics/economics by chapter discipline; 'n' is the chapter's position in the combined Part 1 + Part 2 book. Part 2 chapter titles (n=10-16: Oceans and Life; Life on Earth; Building a Resilient India (1000-1700 CE); India and the World-I (1900 BCE-1200 CE); Authority; From Ideas to Startups; Smart Ways to Manage Your Finances) come from a secondary source (studyrankers) and the numbering/discipline assignment is inferred — UNVERIFIED against the printed book. 'Understanding Social Science' (ch 1) is an introduction to all disciplines and is placed under history.
Grade 9 Science (Exploration): only one 13-chapter volume (First Edition April 2026) was found; no Part 2 was reported. Verify whether a second volume is issued.
Grade 9 Hindi (Ganga): sources differ slightly — one lists 14 items including two supplementary 'साथ-साथ पढ़ें' pieces; the 12-chapter core list is used here.
Grade 10: NCERT confirmed no new Class 10 books in 2026-27 (new books from 2027-28). Rationalised (2023-24 onwards) NCERT books are used.

Grade 10 Maths — deleted from rationalised NCERT/CBSE syllabus: chapter 'Constructions' (entire chapter); within chapters, removed topics include Euclid's division lemma, area of a triangle (coordinate geometry), frustum of a cone, conversion of solids/more-than-two-solid combinations, step-deviation mean and cumulative-frequency graphs, proofs of some similarity theorems. (Per Oswaal deleted-syllabus 2026-27 list; treat sub-topic list as secondary-source.)

Grade 10 Science — deleted chapters (since 2023-24 rationalisation, still out for 2026-27): Periodic Classification of Elements, Sources of Energy, Sustainable Management of Natural Resources; 'Heredity and Evolution' reduced to 'Heredity'. CBSE 2026-27 Unit V lists only 'Our Environment'.

Grade 10 Social Science per 2026-27 syllabus: History ch 4 'The Age of Industrialisation' is for periodic assessment only; Geography ch 7 'Lifelines' map work only in board exam; Economics ch 5 'Consumer Rights' (in book) is not in the syllabus (project work) and is omitted. Democratic Politics-II chapters removed in rationalisation: Democracy and Diversity, Popular Struggles and Movements, Challenges to Democracy.

Grade 10 Hindi: Course A (Kshitij-2 + Kritika-2) shown; Course B uses Sparsh-2 + Sanchayan-2. Rationalisation removed from Kshitij-2: Dev (Savaiya/Kavitt), Chhaya Mat Chhoona, Kanyadaan, Manaviya Karuna ki Divya Chamak (and earlier others); Kritika-2: Ehi Thaiyan Jhulani Herani Ho Rama, George Pancham ki Naak.
Sanskrit is listed for Grades 6-10 as the usual third language (6-8) / optional language (9-10); Grade 9 Sanskrit 'Sharada' chapter list is from a secondary source (educart) — UNVERIFIED.

UNVERIFIED / secondary-source-only chapter lists (verify against NCERT PDFs before publishing): Grade 1 Hindi Sarangi (sources disagree on a few titles, e.g. 'रीना का दिन' vs 'मीना का दिन', 'तीन साथी' vs 'तीन हाथी'); Grade 4 Santoor and Veena; Grade 4 Our Wondrous World (from a 2026-27 school academic plan); Grade 5 Santoor and Veena (ch 9 'न्याय' uncertain); Grade 6 Poorvi chapters 6-16 and Exploring Society Grade 6 (from memory of the official book, consistent with partial listings); Grade 7 and 8 Malhar (10 chapters each per two secondary sources); Grade 8 Exploring Society Part 2 order (teachoo); Grade 9 Kaveri (prose/poem pairing inferred).
Grade 1 and 2 books also have a 'Vidyapravesh' school-readiness module and end-of-book puzzles/revision; these are not counted as chapters.
Topic phrases are short paraphrases written for the app, not official learning outcomes.
